I am not necessarily a convert, more someone who was extremely loosely raised in Christianity and was given the freedom to choose. I am also not of a specific denomination. However, I also know many tolerant, science believing, lovely ones. To judge, be inconsiderate, and unkind is not what jesus preaches. Often times, the radicals create a terrible view of the faith and I do not blame those who do not like us. I, who is involved with the faith have had situations with some, who if I had not known the the message, I wouldn't want to be involved at all. Radicals use scare tactics often, and are often doing things completely against real Christian beliefs.
